title: Sensor stream file (v1)
description: One JSONL (newline-delimited JSON) sensor stream on disk; each line is one validated sensor sample. Units are fixed per sensor kind and documented in docs/capture-pipeline.md.

file_path.description: Path relative to the project directory (JSONL).

units.description: accelerometer: g (1 g = 9.80665 m/s^2), device frame · gyroscope: rad/s, device frame · magnetometer: microtesla (uT), device frame.

requested_interval_ms.description: Interval requested from the OS. The achieved interval is measured per sample (delta_ms) and never assumed equal to this.

sample_count.description: Set only from real subscription callbacks — never estimated.

finalized.description: True once the file was finalized cleanly (handle closed, hash computed).

epoch_ms.description: Wall clock (Date.now), UTC — provenance only, can jump.

monotonic_ms.description: Monotonic clock (performance.now origin) — basis for durations and within-boot alignment.
